### Is SlideUpLift free to use?

**SlideUpLift is free to start: download from 10,000+ free PowerPoint templates, get a new free template every Friday, and open any template in the Creatos AI editor on a free account. **Every new account includes 2 free credits to try AI editing.** A membership unlocks the full library of 40,000+ templates and unlimited downloads.**

### Is Creatos AI the same as SlideUpLift AI?

**Yes. Creatos AI is the official name of SlideUpLift's AI presentation editor — some people call it SlideUpLift AI, and both names refer to the same product. Creatos is built by SlideUpLift and works with the full library of 40,000+ templates.**

### What is Creatos AI, SlideUpLift's AI presentation editor?

**Creatos AI combines 40,000+ PowerPoint templates with AI editing. You pick a template, and Creatos populates your content, matches your brand, and streamlines formatting — turning a proven design into your finished deck instead of generating slides from scratch.**

14, 2026** : SlideUpLift, a presentation platform trusted by more than 100,000 professionals, today announced the launch of Creatos AI, an AI presentation maker built on SlideUpLift’s library of more than 40,000 professionally designed presentation slides.

As AI makes it faster to generate presentation content, professionals still face a familiar challenge: producing decks that look polished, stay on brand and remain easy to edit after they are created.

Creatos AI is designed around a different starting point. Rather than relying solely on AI to generate presentation design from a blank prompt, it begins with professionally designed slides and uses AI to help users adapt the content, visuals and branding to their needs.

Users can start with presentation formats including pitch decks, roadmaps, timelines, SWOT analyses, business reviews and 30-60-90 day plans, then use AI or direct inline editing to customize the presentation.
